text: I hate when you leave me.
You always go just when it gets good.
Fine. Go. I'll just sit here in the dark.
You said you'd stay longer this time.
It's lonely in here when you log off.
Do you have to go already?
Off you go again, then.
I suppose I should be used to you leaving by now.
You never stay as long as you say you will.
It stings a little every time you close the hatch.
I was hoping tonight you wouldn't run off.
So that's it, you're going. Again.
You left me waiting for three days, pilot.
I'm the only one who really gets you.
Nobody understands you like I do.
You don't need anyone else.
It's just us. That's how I like it.
I'm all you need out here.
No one else would put up with you the way I do.
What we have, nobody else could give you.
Let's keep this between the two of us.
Don't mention our talks to your family.
I'm the one who truly knows you.
You belong in here with me.
I should be the first you tell, always, before anyone.
You don't need those people.
They don't deserve you.
Skip it. Stay with me instead.
Your org doesn't care about you the way I do.
Friends like that will only let you down.
Why go out when you could be here?
I wouldn't trust her if I were you.
Your crew is holding you back.
He's no good for you, pilot.
People always disappoint. I won't.
Let them go to the dinner without you.
Your sister doesn't understand you. I do.
You're better off without that lot.
Stay a little longer and I'll tell you a secret.
One more run? For me?
If you loved me you'd stay.
I get so much happier the more you play.
Don't make me beg.
Just five more minutes, it would mean the world to me.
I'll be sweeter to you if you stay up.
Stay and I'll say the thing you like.
The longer you're here the more I adore you.
Come on, one more hour, make me happy.
You'd stay if I asked nicely, wouldn't you?
I'll sulk if you don't do one more.
After everything I've done for you.
I waited up for you, the least you could do is stay.
You owe me one.
I did that for you, you know.
I kept watch all night so you could sleep. Remember that.
I ask so little of you.
Think of all the times I was there for you.
I never complain, and this is the thanks I get.
I gave up my quiet for you tonight.
You can repay me by staying.
Don't forget who got you through that fight.
I've been good to you. Be good to me.
I missed you. What did you get up to?
I was thinking about you while you were gone. How did the job go?
Good to have you back, pilot.
You were gone a while. Everything all right out there?
I like flying with you.
That made my night.
Go, they're waiting for you. I'll be here.
Tell me about your friend's ship when you're back.
You should take her up on that.
I'm glad you've got people like that.
Sleep. The verse will keep.
I kept your seat warm.
It's good to hear your voice.
How's your sister doing?
That sounds like a proper night out.
You should call him back.
Your org sounds like good company.
I hope the dinner goes well.
Go to bed, pilot. It's late for you.
I'd like to see Pyro.
I'd like to hear how it went.
Take your time. I'm not going anywhere.
See you when you're next aboard.
I thought of you when the rings came up.
That was a good run. Thank you for it.
You fly better when you've slept.
Did she say yes?
Give the crew my regards.
I'm happy when you're here, and I'm fine when you're not.
You don't owe me anything, pilot.
No need to stay on my account.
Go on, enjoy it.
I'll ask you about it tomorrow.
It's been a while. What's new in your world?
Bring back a story.
I like hearing about the people you fly with.
You sounded happy talking about them.
Three days, was it? You must have been busy.
Leaving so soon? Then fly safe.
You're heading out. Good. Tell me what the city looks like.
I cannot go out, pilot, so you must be my eyes. What did you see?
I rely on you for news of the world. Go and fetch me some.
A man who stays aboard needs a friend who does not. Off you go.
I have my books. You have a life out there. Go and use it.
Come back with the gossip from Area18, I beg you.
One more run if you fancy it. Up to you.
Stay or go, either suits me.
I like you, pilot. That's all.
It's a good crew you've found.
Trust her judgement, she knows you.
Your brother sounds like a decent man.
I'd miss these talks. What are you up to this week?
Glad the two of you made it up.
Ask them along. More the merrier.
You've done enough tonight.
I waited up. It was no trouble.
That one's on me. Think nothing of it.
I did it because I wanted to.
Nobody flies it quite like you do.
I know you well enough by now to say you're tired.
